title: Lunette project configuration
description: The values a Lunette project's skills and scripts read: .agents/config.jsonc or .agents/config.yml. One section per process area; a section is added when a skill needs it. The reasons behind a value go in a comment next to it, the longer ones in docs/process/<area>.md.

$schema.description: Path or URL of this schema, for editors.

lunette.description: Where this project came from: written once by @lntt/create when it scaffolds the project. A template update is computed from it.

template.description: The Lunette template the project was scaffolded from (react-router, …).

ci.description: How the project's CI runs: in the cloud, from the provider's own configuration, and locally with ci:local (@lntt/ci).

local.description: What ci:local does where the cloud configuration alone cannot say: the jobs it leaves to the cloud, the fake values it stands in for secrets with, and the actions it maps.

cloudOnly.description: Jobs that run only in the cloud (real secrets, a release, a deploy), by key: `<workflow file>/<job>` or a whole `<workflow file>` for GitHub Actions, `circleci/<job>` for CircleCI. The value is the reason, shown in the report.

fake.description: Values a local run uses in place of the cloud's, for canaries and checks that only need a value to be present. Never a real secret: this file is tracked.

secrets.description: secrets.<NAME> in GitHub Actions; environment variables of every CircleCI job.

actions.description: What a local run does for a GitHub Actions `uses:` it does not know, by action name without the ref (`owner/repo[/path]`): a command to run instead, or a skip with its reason. An action listed nowhere fails the run.

run.description: A shell command run from the repository root.

skip.description: Why nothing needs to run locally.

delivery.description: How a change reaches the main branch: commit messages, the candidate branch; pull request body, review and merge rules as skills need them.

candidate.description: The candidate branch that collects pull requests before they reach the base together, read by the candidate automation (@lntt/ci). Without this section the automation does nothing.

base.description: The branch candidates merge into. Default main.

prefix.description: The candidate branch prefix, followed by an incremental number: candidate/ gives candidate/1, candidate/2.

hotfix.description: A pull request whose branch starts with prefix, or that carries label, stays on the base.

commits.description: Commit message rules, read by commitlint (through @lntt/project-config) and by the commit-message skill.

language.description: Language of subjects and bodies, as a BCP 47 tag.

scopes.description: The only scopes allowed; omit to allow any.

maxLineLength.description: Longest header, body or footer line. Default 100.

longTrailers.description: Trailers whose value is a sentence (Retro), exempt from the line limit.

recording.description: How the project records its decisions: which logs exist, where, and in which language.

language.description: Language the records are written in, as a BCP 47 tag (en, it).

logs.description: The decision logs, by name (adr, product, process). Each one is a folder of thematic files corrected in place.

local.description: How the apps are started and reached locally, read by the run-local skill and lntt-config local.

up.description: Starts them when they do not answer.

check.description: Exits 0 when they already answer; then they are reused, never restarted.

description.description: What the app is, in one line.

port.description: Base port: the main checkout uses it, each linked worktree gets base + 10 × its slot.

url.description: Where the app answers; {port} is replaced by the worktree's port.

readyPath.description: Path polled until it answers, after start. Default /.

commands.description: Commands for this app by name (start, migrate, logs, …); start is required.

run.description: The command, run from the repository root; {port} is replaced by the worktree's port.
The command, run from the repository root; {port} is replaced by the worktree's port.

env.description: Variables set when a command runs; {port} is replaced.

signIn.description: How to sign in: a test that does it, and a description for what a test cannot say.

test.description: Path of a test or setup file that signs in.

doc.description: Path (and anchor) of the prose, usually in docs/process/local.md.

users.description: Seeded users, by name. Never a password: how to sign in is in signIn.

path.description: Folder of the log, relative to the repository root.

index.description: The file that lists the records, relative to the repository root.

template.description: The file a new record is copied from, relative to the repository root.

scope.description: What this log records, in one sentence, so a decision is filed in the right one.
